content:
sam: Quick sync  opened a PR to fix pagination + streaming snippets across py/ts/go. A few surprises surfaced in the snippet test harness. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4472

mei: Which surprises? I saw TypeScript compile errors in CI earlier about DOM types leaking into the snippet bundle.

derek: For Go the snippet used pre-generics iterator signatures; updated to idiomatic channel+range pattern. Also found one example still using `page_token` and `page_size`.

aria: Python had an async example using callbacks which we don't ship anymore. I replaced with `async for msg in client.stream_messages(...)` and added an inline migration note.

sam: Nice. Mini checklist for the PRs: 1) update example captions to include target SDK (`@sdk:>=2.1.0`), 2) run snippet-tests, 3) add 1-line migration note near examples, 4) add small unit compile test for Go/TS.

mei: TS fix: added `skipLibCheck: true` to the snippet test tsconfig to avoid DOM noise and switched retry example to `withRetries({ attempts: 3, backoff: 'exponential' })`. Preview: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood/4472-ts

derek: Go helper added: `helpers.DropEmptyPages(pages chan Page) chan Page` with comment explaining trailing-empty-page behavior. Test added: `examples/go/stream_helper_test.go` asserts helper filters empty pages. Branch: docs/go/4473.

aria: I added the migration note: "If upgrading from SDK v1.x, rename `next_cursor` -> `cursor`, `page_size` -> `limit`. Use DropEmptyPages helper in Go for parity." Kept it short.

sam: docs-bot created previews for branches. docs-bot: preview built for 4472, 4473 (status: success) :white_check_mark:

mei: One oddity: the python snippet-tests flagged a flake where the streaming generator yielded a `None` payload on connection reset. I added a defensive `if msg is None: continue` in the example and a short note about connection retries.

derek: Good call. For Go the example demonstrates `for p := range DropEmptyPages(client.StreamMessages(ctx, opts)) { ... }` and explicitly mentions to check `err` after loop.

aria: Also added a small v1-compat block under the migration guide showing a one-line helper for older users: `resp.cursor = resp.next_cursor` with a comment.

sam: Can we cherrypick these docs changes into `release/2.1`? Some customers on enterprise plan will want the snippet fixes before the SDK cut.

docs-bot: cherrypick task created: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/DOCS-1023-cherrypick-snippet-fixes

mei: Linter caught a spacing nit in one of the TS examples; fixed and pushed.

derek: Go CI passes on my branch; added a note in the PR description about the behavioral diff and the helper.

sam: Great. After merges, please add an item in release notes: "Docs: standardized pagination/streaming snippets (cursor/limit), added DropEmptyPages helper for Go, examples target SDK >=2.1.0." Keep it under Docs.

aria: Will do. One follow-up: please run a quick grep across the repo for `page_token|next_cursor|page_size` so we don't miss other spots. I can run that and open follow-up PRs.

sam: Thanks team. If everything green, I'll merge later today. :thumbsup:
